_source: MITRE ATT&CK for Mobile. Hand-curated to the techniques this system can actually evidence.
_note: Only techniques referenced by drishti/m2_static/sinks.py or rules/permission_combos.yaml appear here. A technique with no evidence path would be a claim we cannot ground.

T1056.name: Input Capture
T1056.description: Capture user input, typically by drawing over another app or abusing accessibility.

T1095.name: Non-Application Layer Protocol
T1095.description: Communicate over raw sockets rather than HTTP, bypassing inspection.

T1406.name: Obfuscated Files or Information
T1406.description: Hide code or strings, commonly via reflection or packing.

T1407.name: Download New Code at Runtime
T1407.description: Fetch and execute code after installation, defeating install-time review.

T1412.name: Capture SMS Messages
T1412.description: Read incoming SMS, the primary OTP interception path.

T1414.name: Clipboard Data
T1414.description: Read the clipboard, commonly to swap cryptocurrency addresses.

T1417.name: Input Injection
T1417.description: Abuse accessibility services to observe or drive the UI of other apps.

T1418.name: Software Discovery
T1418.description: Enumerate installed packages, often to gate a payload on a target bank being present.

T1426.name: System Information Discovery
T1426.description: Read device and SIM identifiers, often as a geo or logic-bomb gate.

T1437.name: Application Layer Protocol
T1437.description: Use HTTP or similar to reach command infrastructure.

T1513.name: Screen Capture
T1513.description: Capture the screen, including content from other applications.

T1521.name: Encrypted Channel
T1521.description: Encrypt traffic or payloads, including custom cryptography.

T1537.name: Transfer Data to Cloud Account
T1537.description: Move collected data to attacker-controlled storage.

T1582.name: SMS Control
T1582.description: Send or manipulate SMS without user action, enabling fraud and propagation.

T1623.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
T1623.description: Execute shell commands on the device.

T1626.name: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism
T1626.description: Exercise device-admin authority, commonly to resist uninstall.

T1628.name: Hide Artifacts
T1628.description: Conceal the app's own presence, such as hiding its launcher icon.

T1636.name: Protected User Data
T1636.description: Access contacts, call logs, SMS or notification content.
